projects.description: A Windows kernel-mode EDR/XDR framework written in Rust on windows-drivers-rs.
lines: ### A Windows kernel-mode EDR/XDR framework written in Rust on windows-drivers-rs.
Leviathan is a Windows kernel-mode driver framework in Rust. It registers
process, thread, image, registry and object callbacks, runs a rule and
behaviour engine mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, scans pool tags for memory
forensics, detects hooks, supports ELAM, and streams telemetry to user mode
over a lock-free ring buffer and ETW.
Built with Rust · Windows · KMDF · ETW

projects.description: A prevention-focused living-off-the-land testing framework mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
lines: ### A prevention-focused living-off-the-land testing framework mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Atomic Prevention flips Atomic Red Team: instead of testing detection, it
tests whether preventative controls block living-off-the-land techniques. It
ingests LOLBAS, LOLDrivers, LOLRMM and Atomic Red Team, maps them to ATT&CK
techniques and adversary groups, generates a playbook per group, runs it
with a PowerShell agent and reports what was blocked, detected or allowed.
Built with Python · PowerShell · Docker · MITRE ATT&CK

projects.description: A CLI and web UI for running Firecracker microVMs, an alternative to firectl.
lines: ### A CLI and web UI for running Firecracker microVMs, an alternative to firectl.
Agni manages Firecracker microVMs from a command line and a web interface:
create, start, stop and delete VMs, open a serial console, save
configuration profiles and watch status and logs. Agni is Sanskrit for fire.
Built with Go · Firecracker · KVM · Linux

Krustron is a Kubernetes-native platform that brings multi-cluster

Built with Go · Kubernetes · ArgoCD · Docker

projects.description: File monitoring for Linux in Rust, with inotify and eBPF and timestamped audit logs.
lines: ### File monitoring for Linux in Rust, with inotify and eBPF and timestamped audit logs.
ebpf-file-monitor tracks access, open, close, modify, create, delete, move
and attribute events on a file, records the process, user and size change
behind each one with millisecond timestamps, and writes text or JSON.

projects.description: Your own autonomous system on one VPS, as a Docker Compose stack.
lines: ### Your own autonomous system on one VPS, as a Docker Compose stack.
Convoy runs BGP with RPKI route origin validation (BIRD 2, Routinator), an
authoritative DNSSEC zone (NSD), a public NTP server with NTS (chrony), mail
with DKIM and DANE (Postfix, Dovecot) and HTTP/3 (nginx) on one host. An
offline lab runs 32 end-to-end checks before anything is deployed.
Built with Shell · Docker · BGP · DNSSEC
